correctness.rationale: Exact weighted Laplacian eigenspace decomposition (dimensions sum to rm), Kirchhoff determinant, injective edge-to-grounded-Laplacian map and strict logdet concavity establish a unique full-space optimizer. The budget-reduced derivative is the sign of C+Lt-At^2 with A>0; C>0 gives one positive root and C<=0 entails L<0 and screening at t=0. Critical scaling follows algebraically, independently of finite tests. Standalone exact-rational verifier replay checks 7,798 cases.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new statement is not the known tree polynomial, convexity, or a simple relabeling of a prior reported optimizer. It adds an all-parameter unique unrestricted conductance optimum and identifies the price threshold at which an entire admissible edge orbit disappears, plus a sharp critical scaling. Related cactus, complete two-community, perfect-matching and hypercube design families have nonisomorphic feasible graph supports and distinct budget orbits, so their claims do not imply this one.

value.rationale: A natural price-constrained network D-optimal design problem gets a complete all-dimension unique optimizer, sharp edge-orbit removal threshold, explicit interior conductance ratio, and a 1/m critical window. Unlike a mere enumeration, it changes what edges are worth constructing under a budget and gives a directly applicable allocation rule. Finite/known-table recomputation is not the claim.
